paras: Monopeltis luandae is a species of amphisbaenian in the family Amphisbaenidae. The species is endemic to Angola.
The preferred natural habitat of M. luandae is savanna, at altitudes of 20–150 m (66–492 ft).
M. luandae may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 38.5 cm (15.2 in). Dorsally, it is speckled with dark pigment.
The mode of reproduction of M. luandae is unknown.
